class.name: piper_control/PiperHardware
class.description: CAN bus hardware interface for the Piper robotic arm. Communicates via SocketCAN (linux/can.h) to read joint states and write position commands. Supports 6 revolute arm joints and 1 prismatic gripper joint. Joint8 (right finger) is configured as a mimic of joint7 in the URDF and is not directly controlled.
